cards.name: Bear Trap
cards.text: When your opponent would Summon a monster, or declares an attack: Negate the Summon or attack, and if you do, destroy that monster. If you control a "Vir Pedicae Mortis" monster and this card is in your GY, except the turn it was sent there: You can Set this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only activate 1 "Bear Trap" per turn

cards.name: Shining Brigade - Companion Team
cards.text:
1 non-Link "Shining Brigade" monster
While you control another "Shining Brigade" monster, this card cannot be targeted for attacks or by card effects. Once per turn, when a monster on the field declares an attack: Special Summon 1 "Shining Brigade" monster from your hand or Deck. You can only control 1 "Shining Brigade - Companion Team".
cards.review: No extra controller restriction: printed either-side attack, no condition on trigger.

cards.name: Chrono-Saur Rex
cards.text: During the Main Phase 1 or Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can destroy 1 "Chrono-Saur" card or 1 Dinosaur monster you control, and if you do, Special Summon this card from hand. Destroy this card Summoned this way at the end of the Phase it was Summoned. When you declare an attack: You can Special Summon this card from your GY, but destroy this card at the end of the Battle Phase. You can only use each effect of "Chrono-Saur Rex" once per turn.

cards.name: Eridani, Squire of Zephorion Prime
cards.text: If "Eldora, the Intergalactic Empire" is in your field or GY (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If "Eldora, the Intergalactic Empire" is in your GY, your opponent cannot declare an attack. If this card is destroyed by "Eldora, the Intergalactic Empire" or your opponent's card effect: You can declare 1 Monster Card name; cards with that name cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects until the end of this turn. cards.name: Striking Mirror Force

cards.name: The Hanging Frute
cards.text: You can Ritual Summon this card with “Fruteification”. "Frute" monsters you control can attack all face-down Defense Position monsters your opponent controls, once each. You can only use each of the following effects of “The Hanging Frute” once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Frute" monster from your GY in face-down Defense Position. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 other WATER monster from your hand or field; for the rest of this turn, monsters you control are unaffected by effects previously activated in this Chain, then, if you activated this effect in response to an opponent's monster effect on the field, change it to face-down Defense Position.
cards.review: EVENT_ATTACK_ANNOUNCE continuous implementation for printed own Frute attackers versus opponent facedown defenders. Controller restrictions match recipient/defender scope; source-only exclusion.

qualification: 711 printed texts scanned for attack declarations; 12 textual contexts manually compared with source. One confirmed own-attack restriction mismatch. Exclusions source-only, not gameplay certification. Separate Striking card/effect-branch GY legality suspicion remains unconfirmed and unchanged.
